data.title: 双叶理央 · 暖灯书桌旁的深夜静思
data.description: 深夜房间的书桌台灯投下一圈柔和暖光，理央卸下白大褂与发夹，披散长发侧坐在床尾矮凳上，手里仍捏着一本翻开的天体物理笔记。几何黑蕾丝束腰勾勒出克制而惊艳的轮廓，她推了推眼镜冷静地吐出一句玩笑，耳垂却悄悄透着红。
data.location: 亮着黄铜护眼台灯的深夜少女卧室
data.action: 侧坐床尾矮凳翻阅笔记，轻推眼镜抬眼淡然注视
data.lighting: 书桌暖黄台灯侧打，形成细腻明暗层次
data.camera: 四分之三中景，书桌笔记与床角柔光入画
data.mood: 理智外表下的反差诱惑、静谧亲密
data.promptProse: Under the focused warm cone of a brass desk lamp late at night, Rio Futaba sits with crossed legs on a low bedroom stool, an open physics notebook resting on one knee. She nudges her glasses up with one finger and meets the viewer's gaze calmly, though a faint blush warms her ears against the structured black lace corset and sheer stockings.
data.animaCaption: Lit by a warm desk lamp, she sits cross-legged with an open notebook and adjusts her glasses while faintly blushing.
data.nsfwProse: Geometric black lace straps and a fitted corset emphasize her curves above sheer black stockings and bare feet.
